description: Weight-free result exports for the completed TI-TNN experiments, byte-identical to the files each run wrote under the git-ignored runs/ directory.

toy_benchmarks.what: routing and compositional-isolation toy benchmarks, 3 seeds, GPU (re-run after the isolation fix)
toy_benchmarks.source: the working tree committed as c079459 (the run preceded that commit by 16 minutes)

unsupervised_routing.what: routing with no route or gate labels, 3 seeds, GPU

real_benchmarks.what: WikiText-103 (15 runs) and SCAN (60 runs), 3 seeds each; legacy expert initialization
real_benchmarks.source: 316c18f (the queue's relaunch, per the protocol's execution record)

functorial_composition.what: composition from single relations, 5 seeds, GPU

functorial_composition_controls.command: python research/ti_tnn/composition.py --device cpu --variants functorial ortho_tied ortho_untied shared soft_full soft linear --out runs/titnn_composition_controls

adaptive_compute.what: adaptive compute: part A lookup task (36 runs) and part B WikiText-103 (21 new runs; dense, moe_top1 and moe_top2 are reused from real_benchmarks/lm), batch-1 latency, and the evaluator's verdict with its run manifest
adaptive_compute.source: 64ecc86 (training); evaluation by frontier.py and latency.py at d9a8c1f, per the protocol's execution record
adaptive_compute.command: GATE=<gate> bash research/ti_tnn/bench/run_efficiency.sh; python research/ti_tnn/bench/frontier.py --hops runs/titnn_efficiency/hops --lm runs/titnn_bench/lm runs/titnn_efficiency/lm --latency runs/titnn_efficiency/latency.json --source runs/titnn_bench/lm=316c18f --source runs/titnn_efficiency=64ecc86 --out runs/titnn_efficiency/frontier.json

adaptive_compute_init_control.what: WikiText-103 with dense-matched expert initialization: ti_tnn_adaptive_c30 and moe_top1, seeds 0-2; batch-1 latency; step-0 residual RMS and routing diagnostics; the separate analysis (frozen version and the version with the run_key path fix)
adaptive_compute_init_control.source: 630cab2 (training; recorded in each run); analysis by frontier.py --init-control
adaptive_compute_init_control.command: GATE=<gate> bash research/ti_tnn/bench/run_init_control.sh; python research/ti_tnn/bench/frontier.py --lm runs/titnn_bench/lm runs/titnn_efficiency/lm --init-control runs/titnn_efficiency/lm_init_control --latency runs/titnn_efficiency/latency_init_control.json
adaptive_compute_init_control.note: Eight files had absolute local paths (the run script passed absolute roots); the prefix was removed for publication. Each such file lists its original sha256, which the analysis's run manifest refers to.

lookup_init_check.what: lookup task: moe_top1 with dense-matched expert initialization, seeds 0-2 (frozen check)

lookup_learning_diagnostics.what: EXPLORATORY: every development-seed run (seeds 100-103, plus one seed-0 reproduction) used to diagnose the lookup-task learning failures; not pre-registered results
lookup_learning_diagnostics.source: 1ac2b1c to fb39904 on ti-tnn-learnable-adaptive / ti-tnn-learnfix-dev (recorded in each run)

adaptive_compute_part_a_v2.what: part A v2: the lookup task with learning fixed, seeds 200-204, 18,000 steps, and the frozen evaluator's output
adaptive_compute_part_a_v2.source: 2a34728 (recorded in each run); evaluation by frontier.py --hops-v2 at dcf115d
adaptive_compute_part_a_v2.command: GATE=<gate> bash research/ti_tnn/bench/run_part_a_v2.sh; python research/ti_tnn/bench/frontier.py --hops-v2 runs/titnn_efficiency/hops_v2 --out runs/titnn_efficiency/frontier.json

adaptive_compute_wikitext_fixed.what: WikiText-103: ti_tnn_adaptive_c30 with the lookup-task fixes (dense-matched init, shared expert, cap warm-up, visible skipped tokens), seeds 0-2; batch-1 latency; the frozen analysis's output
adaptive_compute_wikitext_fixed.source: 16bba5c (recorded in each run); analysis by frontier.py --wikitext-fixed
adaptive_compute_wikitext_fixed.command: GATE=<gate> bash research/ti_tnn/bench/run_wikitext_fixed.sh; python research/ti_tnn/bench/frontier.py --lm runs/titnn_bench/lm runs/titnn_efficiency/lm runs/titnn_efficiency/lm_init_control --wikitext-fixed runs/titnn_efficiency/lm_wikitext_fixed --latency runs/titnn_efficiency/latency_wikitext_fixed.json --out runs/titnn_efficiency/frontier_wf.json

typed_composition.what: learned relation operators on finite typed worlds 200-202, inits 0-4, five families (specialists, shared dense, flat top-1 MoE, endpoint-only negative control, answer-only), CPU; and the frozen evaluator's verdict
typed_composition.source: ef604a1 (committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit)

semantic_interventions.what: execution records, replay, probes, disabled computation and interventions on worlds 300-302: the four learned families (inits 0-4), the table modules and three deliberately faulty sets, CPU; and the frozen evaluator's verdict
semantic_interventions.source: 75cb47a (committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit)

typed_routing.what: controlled-language questions, a learned interpreter and calibrated abstention on worlds 400-402 (48 countries), inits 0-4: three typed systems sharing the interpreter and an answer-only baseline, CPU; and the frozen evaluator's verdict
typed_routing.source: fd0aa20 (committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit)

typed_recurrence.what: bounded recurrence on route worlds 500-502 (48 countries), inits 0-4: recurrence with learned specialists, the fixed-depth control and recurrence with tables; answers, stopping reasons, pause/resume at every pause point, applications, MACs and timing, one CPU thread; and the frozen evaluator's verdict
typed_recurrence.source: 7ba0b79 (committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit)

local_updates.what: offline module replacement on worlds 600-602, inits 0-4: 10 single-fact updates per world for specialists, a same-data shared network and a rehearsal shared network, each through every gate with activation and rollback; and a faulty suite per world, CPU; and the frozen evaluator's verdict
local_updates.source: dd1d937 (committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit)

local_updates_post_repair.what: the module-replacement confirmation rerun after the contract repairs (sealed, bound check results; frozen, digested snapshots; exact inventories), same worlds, inits and command; its verdict must equal the original's
local_updates_post_repair.source: the contract-repair branch ti-tnn-contract-repairs (uncommitted working tree at the time of the rerun; committed with it)

adaptive_compute_shared_path_control.what: lookup task, shared-path control: a half-width dense model (the shared path alone) and a one-expert TI-TNN at the 0.3 cap, seeds 200-204, 18,000 steps; and the frozen evaluator's output
adaptive_compute_shared_path_control.source: 9da9c82 (recorded in each run); evaluation by frontier.py --shared-control at 9da9c82
adaptive_compute_shared_path_control.command: GATE=<gate> bash research/ti_tnn/bench/run_shared_path_control.sh; python research/ti_tnn/bench/frontier.py --shared-control runs/titnn_efficiency/hops_shared_control --hops-v2 runs/titnn_efficiency/hops_v2 --out runs/titnn_efficiency/frontier_sc.json

interpreter_robustness.what: interpreter robustness confirmation: worlds 700-702 (96 countries) x inits 0-4 x four arms (word, word_aug, char, char_aug) plus the grammar control; the aggregate summaries, the frozen verdict, all 15 per-unit full-precision decision records (calibration and test, every arm and the grammar control, gzip-compressed JSON) and the verifier's output
interpreter_robustness.source: 69b7fd7 (the frozen revision 4, committed immediately before the run; the run file does not record its commit); the corrected verifier is in the commit that adds this bundle

s2_diagnosis.what: S2 diagnosis: the classification of every S2 question in the interpreter robustness confirmation records; six instrumented development fits of the word_aug recipe (arm A, worlds 100-101 x inits 100-102) with their full-precision greedy and teacher-forced traces; 18 development fits of the training-data interventions B (exposure), C (real-word wrappers) and D (taught two-step supervision) with their decision records; the development analysis; the hashes of the traces not bundled; where those traces are published (release ti-tnn-s2-diagnosis-traces-v1, trace_release.json); rebuild every trace table with make_tables.py --s2-traces
s2_diagnosis.source: 6435719 (record analysis); ece0f86 (arm A fits, recorded in the run); d991d12 (B, C, D fits, committed immediately before them, recorded in the run)
s2_diagnosis.command: python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_diagnosis.py experiments/results/ti_tnn/interpreter_robustness/20261018T232057 --out <dir>; python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_development.py --arms A; python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_development.py --arms B C D; python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_development_analysis.py <both runs> --out <dir>

s2_context_confirmation.what: S2 diagnosis, fresh confirmation of arms A, B and C: worlds 710-712 (96 countries) x inits 200-204, 45 fits; the run summary, every per-fit decision record and the analysis with the frozen verdict
s2_context_confirmation.source: 07bb97e (frozen; committed immediately before the run; recorded in the run)
s2_context_confirmation.command: python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_development.py --arms A B C --worlds 710 711 712 --inits 200 201 202 203 204 --out runs/titnn_s2_diagnosis/confirmation; python research/ti_tnn/bench/s2_development_analysis.py <run> --out <dir>

integration_test.what: Integration test confirmation: route worlds 800-802 x inits 0-4 (15 units), each with S0 and twelve update branches; the complete export (interpreter draws with parses, scores and release decisions; atomic tables, certificates, serving contexts, exhaustive digests, branch records, compact episode rows) and the independent verifier's output. Full session records are release assets (session_release.json)
integration_test.source: e03075a (frozen revision 4; committed immediately before the run; recorded in the run)

repeated_updates.what: Repeated updates under a bounded replay allowance, confirmation: worlds 900-902 x inits 0-4 (15 units), 38 arms each (32 ordinary shared arms, two references, four specialist arms) over one immutable schedule of 12 one-fact requests per world, up to 8 attempts each; every attempt's weight-free record (training set, errors, table digest, screen, gate outcomes, activation) and the independent verifier's output, with sampled reproduction of 114 chains
repeated_updates.source: e8c6f99 (frozen revision 3; the freezing commit; recorded in the run, with a clean tree)

factored_interpreter.what: Factored interpreter, development engineering result (worlds 100-101 x inits 100-101 x full and reduced exposure; 16 fits of A and F; A+K, F+B, L, G and W evaluated from them), and its no-fit controls with the lexical condition: the original exports at 0e1a3c9 (A+K step traces as release assets, pilot_trace_release.json), their integrity check, the verifiers' outputs and the A+K diagnosis
factored_interpreter.source: 0e1a3c9 (both runs; clean tree; recorded in the runs). No confirmation was run.
